text:
julia: FYI canary shows p99 latency drift (~95ms) for model-group:llama3q after runtime 3.2. Propose temporary runtime pin to 3.1 in eu-central for tonight's 22:00 UTC window. @deploybot can you prepare a reversible soft-pin?

deploybot: noted. soft-pin is reversible, routes new requests to pinned runtime; propagation ~30-60s. Checking compat: llama3q-v2 OK on 3.1. SDK: sdk-go 0.8.x needs shim flag.

ran: last time pinning we saw memory pressure. Suggest pre-warm + an auto-unpin trigger (infra.mem > 82% or telemetry.p99 > 180ms for 5m).

kai: I'll pre-warm pool: `./infra/scale-gpu --region eu-central --pool spare-infer --delta +1 --tag prewarm-pin-1765`

support: Notifying affected customers in eu-central (segment query done). Message queued: "Temporary runtime pin for stability; report errors to support."

julia: timeline: pre-warm 21:30, soft-pin 22:00 (20% traffic), evaluate 22:20, full pin 22:30 if green. auto-unpin triggers enabled.

deploybot: scheduling job id 99123. Logs -> https://deploylogs/release/99123.

ran: I'll own 22:20 check and abort if alerts fire.

kai: pre-warm started, ETA ~8m.

julia: thanks all. will update thread after rollout.
